product.title: Nelly Rapp și Academia Antimonștri
product.description: Când unchiul Hannibal îi invită familia la cină în impresionantul său conac, Nelly Rapp, o puștoaică isteață și foarte curioasă, ajunge fără să-și dea seama cum în banca unei școli neobișnuite, Academia Antimonștri, și în fața unei profesoare căreia va trebui să-i demonstreze că are calitățile necesare unui adevărat agent antimonștri. PRIMA MEA LECTURĂ Această colecție este dedicată tinerilor cititori pasionați de lectură. Textele ilustrate și adaptate la nivelul de înțelegere al copiilor de vârstă școlară oferă o lectură accesibilă și antrenantă, cu ajutorul căreia pot fi exersate fără niciun fel de dificultate abilitățile de citire.

# Nelly Rapp and the Academy of Monsters by Litera

Dive into the exciting world of imagination with *Nelly Rapp and the Academy of Monsters*, a captivating book from Litera. This collection is perfect for young readers who are passionate about storytelling and learning through adventure.

## An Adventure for Young Readers

Follow the journey of the spirited and curious Nelly Rapp as she finds herself unexpectedly placed in the unusual environment of the Academy of Antimonsters. When Uncle Hannibal invites the family to dinner at his impressive manor, Nelly finds herself in the unexpected location of this peculiar school!

The story is designed to be both entertaining and educational, offering accessible texts illustrated and adapted to the comprehension level of school-aged children. This book helps young readers practice their reading abilities without any difficulty, making the learning process fun and engaging.

## Why Choose This Book?

This collection is dedicated to young readers who love to read and explore new worlds. It offers a wonderful blend of fantasy adventure and foundational literacy skills:

*   **Engaging Storytelling:** Captures the imagination of children with an exciting narrative about Nelly Rapp and her encounter with the Academy of Antimonsters.
*   **Accessible Reading:** Texts are adapted to suit the understanding level of school-aged children, ensuring an easy and enjoyable reading experience.
*   **Reading Practice:** Helps young readers exercise and develop their reading skills in a fun, non-strenuous way.
*   **Illustrated Content:** Features engaging illustrations that enhance the story and aid comprehension.

## Product Details

**Brand:** Litera
**Category:** Books
**Price:** $29.99

Discover this fantastic adventure today!

[Shop Nelly Rapp and the Academy of Monsters here](https://www.litera.ro/nelly-rapp-i-academia-antimon-tri)

### Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

**Q: Who is this book for?**
A: This collection is specifically dedicated to young readers who are passionate about reading and exploring imaginative stories.

**Q: Is the content educational?**
A: Yes, the texts are adapted to the comprehension level of school-aged children, making the reading experience accessible and helpful for practicing reading skills.

**Q: What is the price for this book?**
A: The price for *Nelly Rapp and the Academy of Monsters* is $29.99.
